newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka police grill guards in PNG rugger star death.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka police grill guards in PNG rugger star death.

text.p: Sri Lankan police said on Sunday they had questioned six security guards at a casino outside which a Papua New Guinea rugby star was shot dead last week.
Joel Pera, who was the coach at a local rugby club, was shot dead at close range with a nine millimetre pistol around 4.30 a.m. last Thursday.
Police said they had recovered three spent cartridges from the scene of the killing near the casino where Pera had been a patron.
"We do not know the motive for the crime," a police official said. "But we think it was an arguement that led to the killing."
About 20 people, including the club guards, had been questioned over the killing, he said.
Pera had earlier played for another rugby club. He was among several PNG rugby players to play for Sri Lankan clubs.
